name: Propose reorders that keep service levels within stock targets
outcome: Reorder proposals that hold the target service level while lowering stock, produced per item and location and ready for a planner to release.
description: Whether a planner accepts the proposals unchanged is a measure and lives in measures. Acceptance is how the job is judged, not what it is, and it is a number a vendor cannot publish about a customer's planners, so an outcome that requires it can only ever be filled by a measured result. A solution claims this job by producing reorder proposals held against a service target.
